acceptance_criteria: AC-1: exams table exists with all specified columns; status column accepts only 'draft', 'active', 'archived' via ENUM constraint.
AC-2: exam_sections table exists with FK to exams.id ON DELETE CASCADE; sort_order is non-negative.
AC-3: exam_question_rules table exists; mode accepts only 'manual' or 'random'; FK to exams.id ON DELETE CASCADE; FK to exam_sections.id nullable ON DELETE SET NULL.
AC-4: exam_manual_questions table exists with composite PK (rule_id, question_id); FKs with ON DELETE CASCADE.
AC-5: show_answers ENUM accepts only 'never', 'after_completion', 'after_all_attempts'; on_tab_switch ENUM accepts only 'log', 'warn', 'submit'.
AC-6: All UUID primary keys generated via gen_random_uuid().
AC-7: created_at and updated_at default to NOW() UTC; updated_at maintained by trigger.
AC-8: tag_ids stored as JSONB; application validates it is an array of UUID strings.
AC-9: Migration file numbered sequentially; no existing migration edited.
AC-10: All tables have indexes on foreign key columns.
notes: The exams package was already substantially implemented (FR-BB32 was already done). This implementation adds service-layer validations required by FR-BB31: (1) available_from < available_until check in CreateExam, (2) tag_ids UUID format validation in CreateRule and UpdateRule. New tests added: TestCreateExam_Success, TestCreateExam_InvalidAvailability, TestCreateExam_EqualAvailability, TestCreateExam_NilAvailability, TestCreateExam_InvalidTagIDs, TestCreateRule_RandomMode, TestCreateRule_ManualMode, TestCreateRule_ValidUUIDTagIDs, TestSetManualQuestions_Success.
